subject.title: fix(gateway): bound connect frame auth.* fields at the protocol schema

question: Should connect-frame auth credentials be bounded by UTF-8 byte length, closed token syntax, or both, and should local runtime-token fields share the same shared-secret cap?
rationale: This is a pre-auth security boundary and a protocol compatibility change; the exact limits and whether to include local runtime tokens need owner intent rather than a reviewer guessing permanent credential contracts.

options.title: Byte-bound all capped fields
options.body: Require byte-length or closed-shape enforcement for the six changed auth fields and add tests for ASCII plus multibyte/combining inputs before merge.

options.title: Shape-bound machine tokens only
options.body: Use strict shape validation for bootstrap/device tokens and a generous byte cap for shared/runtime secrets if owners want maximum operator compatibility.

options.title: Split runtime-token caps
options.body: Land only the remote-auth schema caps now and move approval/runtime identity token caps to a separate owner-reviewed change.

recommendation.title: Byte-bound all capped fields
recommendation.body: Require byte-length or closed-shape enforcement for the six changed auth fields and add tests for ASCII plus multibyte/combining inputs before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The protocol package extraction and recent schema history make this the best available owner for the protocol-boundary compatibility choice.
